# MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology)

> > A world-leading research university advancing knowledge in science, technology, engineering, and innovation through groundbreaking research, education, and entrepreneurship.

MIT is home to cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence, machine learning, photonics, and spaceflight materials, led by faculty and researchers including President Kornbluth, Song Han, and Andreea Bobu. The institute fosters innovation through programs like MIT InnovationHQ and the Martin Trust Center for MIT Entrepreneurship, while maintaining strong commitments to accessibility and STEM education through initiatives like the MIT4America Calculus Project.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Research & Innovation
- Entrepreneurship & Innovation Ecosystem
- Accessibility & Disability Services
- STEM Education
- Photonics & Materials Science
- President Kornbluth Leadership
- Campus Resources & Support
- Statistical Learning Theory
- Human-Robot Interaction
- Internet Growth & Web Statistics
- Federal Policy Response
- MechE (Mechanical Engineering)
- Assistive Technology
- Curiosity Unbounded

## Core MIT Resources

- [MIT - Massachusetts Institute of Technology](https://www.mit.edu): MIT homepage featuring research highlights, innovation, and President Kornbluth
- [Innovation | MIT](https://www.mit.edu/innovation): MIT entrepreneurship resources via InnovationHQ and Martin Trust Center
- [MIT's response to government activity](https://www.mit.edu/response-government-activity): MIT leadership updates on federal policy and institutional response
- [Accessibility | MIT](https://www.mit.edu/accessibility): MIT accessibility resources including Campus Map and Disability Services

## Research & Faculty

- [Andreea Bobu](https://www.mit.edu/~abobu): Andreea Bobu's faculty profile: human-robot interaction and ML research

## Academic Resources & Course Materials

- [9.520/6.860, Fall 2016](http://www.mit.edu/~9.520/fall16): Statistical learning theory course by Poggio and Rosasco, Fall 2016
- [Math for computer science](https://www.mit.edu/~ashrstnv/math-for-cs.html): Mathematical foundations and asymptotics for computer science
- [Probability and statistics](https://www.mit.edu/~ashrstnv/probability-statistics.html): Probability distributions reference: Bayes, Binomial, Normal, Poisson
- [Classical mechanics](https://www.mit.edu/~ashrstnv/classical-mechanics.html): Classical mechanics notes covering Kepler's laws and Noether's theorem

## Historical & Reference Materials

- [Internet Statistics: Web Growth, Internet Growth](http://www.mit.edu/people/mkgray/net): Historical internet and web growth statistics by Matthew Gray
- [Internet Growth Summary](https://www.mit.edu/people/mkgray/net/internet-growth-summary.html): ARPANET to DNS survey data tracking internet host count growth

## Technical Documentation

- [An Implementation of Scheduler Activations on the NetBSD Operating System](http://www.mit.edu/people/nathanw/usenix): USENIX paper on Scheduler Activations implementation in NetBSD kernel

## Optional

- [Mary Chung's Restaurant menu (historical)](http://www.mit.edu/people/eichin/marys/marysmenu.html): Historical archive of Mary Chung's Restaurant menu in Central Square
- [The Rollo Cheeky Standard](http://www.mit.edu/people/mattski/Rollo/index.html): Fan site for Rollo Armstrong, Faithless, and Cheeky Records discography
- [Tips for 2-Way Prayer (Part II)](http://www.mit.edu/people/rei/spir-elevation.html): Spiritual guidance on two-way prayer and meditation practice
